question: Does R7 (a19-carrier-cohesion-v2) stop the default's walking principal blessing carriers from leaving their army in laps 1-3 without costing the default more than 2 points? K2 and CC asked the same of R6 (a19-carrier-cohesion-v1).
origin: Owner, test game e94392e8: "loosing crusader at the beginning is a mistake, AI needs to be more cautious. As it gives important scaled with luck (leprechaun) blessing to the whole army". In lap 2 the AI's Crusader moved from 1 cell of an ally to 7 cells from the nearest ally, hit the Black Dragon and died the same lap; its Manticore did the same and died in lap 2. A behaviour fix the owner asked for, so the strength gate is non-inferiority, as for the keep-attack fix (profile v21).
rule: R7, a19-carrier-cohesion-v2 (common src/ai/carrier_cohesion.ts and the search driver): R6, except that a carrier that flies (Manticore, Angel) is never held. In laps 1-3 the principal carrier of a blessing that lasts only while it lives (the largest living stack of its creature on its team), if it walks, does not make a move, with or without an attack, from at most 3 cells of its nearest ally to at least 4 cells and at least 2 farther; such a native choice becomes a wait while the hourglass allows one, else a defend, and such challengers are removed. A seat that bought the striker rush (Placement at least 2 and Movement at least 2) is exempt. R6 (a19-carrier-cohesion-v1) held flying carriers too; it passed confirmation K2 and failed confirmation CC at gate CC2, and is not adopted.

screens.result: failed: the isolation rule (R6 without the rush exemption) -0.80 points (95% -4.26 to +2.66), natural population -4.17; the narrower cohesion rule (move-and-attack only, while a wait is left) -2.39 (-5.05 to +0.00). Neither proceeds. After the result, the isolation rule's decided games split by the striker rush: rush armies 0 better, 6 worse; every other army 6 better, 4 worse.
passed all five checks: +0.66 points (95% -1.97 to +3.51; 288 cases); every rush seat (114) played the same game in both arms; principal carriers dead in laps 1-3 179 -> 160.

00f17be324a9320b649c62d411ec3818c4904ff65b62b4b1eae6b76b8b6e2eb2, unchanged: natural, 300 families of draft-shaped

Gates, all required:
K1 non-inferiority: the primary (all cases) 95% lower bound is at least -2 points.
K2 no population estimate (natural, owner, forced-crusader, forced-manticore) is below -2 points.
K3 games with a quality error in the R6 arm are not more than production's.
K4 behaviour: early isolating moves chosen by principal carriers of seats that did not buy the rush are, in the R6 arm,
at most 10% of production's, and production has at least one.
K5 outcome: principal carriers dead in laps 1-3 in the R6 arm are not more than production's.
K6 parity: the first 20 natural cases of the R6 arm reproduce their digests on x3d.
K7 the exemption: every case whose candidate seat bought the rush plays the same game in both arms.
Reported, not gated: per-population differences, the Crusader's early deaths, games changed, decided games split by
the rush.
If every gate passes, R6 is proposed for adoption as A19 profile v29 with the switch on unless "0". A gain is claimed
only if the primary lower bound is above zero. Not claimed: strength against people. A failed gate stays recorded as
failed and is not re-run.
